item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes an internal advisory task force; this is executive organization rather than a change to substantive legal rights or duties.","evidence":"I am establishing a Presidential Task Force on Global Resources and Environment."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns membership, analytical and consultative responsibilities, and reporting duties to an internal presidential task force, with no dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"The Task Force will report to me within six months and periodically thereafter on its progress"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the task force to coordinate, prioritize attention, and assess federal efforts and analytical capacity; these are internal management and study functions.","evidence":"I have directed the Task Force to work closely with you in carrying out its responsibilities"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies must support the task force, which must provide recommendations and progress reports; these are internal cooperation and reporting requirements without a specified legal consequence.","evidence":"Each of your agencies shall cooperate with and support this important Task Force."}]}
